items.h: Internal Interface: SATA I / II / III

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The UGREEN 30847 2.5 Inch USB 3.0 Hard Drive Enclosure is a reliable and high-speed solution for converting internal SATA HDDs and SSDs into portable external storage. Designed with USB 3.0 technology and UASP support, it delivers fast data transfer speeds of up to 5Gbps, ensuring efficient file transfers, backups, and data recovery.


This enclosure supports 2.5-inch SATA I/II/III drives with thickness up to 9.5mm, making it ideal for both HDD and SSD users. The tool-free installation allows quick setup without screws, while the durable ABS body with internal cushioning protects your drive from shocks and scratches.


Perfect for professionals, gamers, and everyday users, the UGREEN 30847 enclosure ensures stable performance across multiple operating systems including Windows, macOS, and Linux.


Key Features


  • USB 3.0 interface with up to 5Gbps high-speed transmission
  • UASP protocol for enhanced performance and lower latency
  • Supports 2.5" SATA HDD & SSD (7mm / 9.5mm)
  • Tool-free installation, plug and play design
  • Durable ABS casing with shockproof internal padding
  • LED indicator for working status
  • Backward compatible with USB 2.0 and USB 1.1
  • Wide compatibility: Windows, macOS, Linux
